verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a 'Workflow API' intended to power AI workflows and integration marketplaces, and a stored-actions endpoint for executing predefined actions, but there is no documented API flow for an agent to create, update, and activate a full Zap workflow end-to-end, and a probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/docs for creating, updating, and activating Zap workflows, and independent confirmation the Workflow API supports full CRUD/activation lifecycle.
